messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PD-4829 fired — p99 latency > 3s for inference-serving.prod (alert: p99_latency > 3000ms for 5m)
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-4829 assigned to jamie (oncall). URL: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4829
jamie (oncall): saw it, acked. ACK
jamie (oncall): looking at console graphs now, tail spike starting ~13:05 UTC
omar: same, p95 also creeping up. Any deploys in last 30m?
jen: nothing in prod deploy log. last rollout at 12:10 — feature/eval-optimizations
matt: checking autoscaler — new pods not coming up, NodeGroup 3 scaling at capacity
luis: KV cache eviction spikes in logs: "evicting prefix cache for model-abc due to mem_pressure"
alice: customer reports latency timeouts on org-realtime-webhooks, some 504s
jamie (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-critical routes 2) fallback to smaller model variant 3) scale up GPU nodes (manual) — executing step 1 now
omar: command to throttle route: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/routes/throttle" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","rate":50}'
```
jen: applied throttling for /v1/generate -> rate=50r/s :white_check_mark:
matt: initiating nodegroup scale: 
```sh
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-inference-ng3 --size=24
```
matt: hit quota error: "QUOTA_EXCEEDED: CPUs in region us-west1"
omar: we have burst credits in dedicated pool, can route traffic there as fallback
jamie (oncall): initiating routing fallback to dedicated for high latency customers. command:
```json
{"action":"route","from":"inference.prod","to":"dedicated-pool-1","filter":"org in [\"enterprise-corp\",\"beta-partner\"]"}
```
luis: KV cache pressure persists — suggest evicting largest prefixes manually for model-abc:
```bash
redis-cli -h kv-cache.prod.del --eval evict_by_prefix.lua model-abc:large
```
alice: noted: support ticket updated, customers affected: enterprise-corp, realtime-proxy (partial failures)
jen: logs show long GC on node i-0ab3 starting 13:07, maybe noisy Java process in sidecar
matt: restarted sidecar on pod inference-abc-12 -> latency improved for that pod
jamie (oncall): good, p99 dropped from 3.6s -> 2.1s after throttling + restart. still above target (1.0s)
omar: will flip canary fallback to model-abc-quantized to reduce token compute cost:
```yaml
- model: model-abc-quant
  rollout: canary
  traffic: 10%
```
jen: monitor evals — quantized quality OK for prompt set "slo-watch"
pagerduty: PD-4829 acknowledged by jamie (oncall) at 2026-03-14T13:12:05Z
incident-bot: added tag "latency-p99" and "partial-customer-impact"
jamie (oncall): document incident in #incidents, creating incident ticket now: INC-2026-0314-1
matt: note — autoscaler metrics show scale delay ~3m due to node provisioning; follow-up to infra team
luis: filing a follow-up RFC for KV cache eviction limits
alice: handing off to omar for next shift at 13:40 UTC — tagging @omar
omar: taking handoff. current status: p99 ~1.9s, p95 ~0.9s, affected orgs on fallback, dedicated pool absorbing 30% traffic
jamie (oncall): thanks — if p99 > 2.5s or errors > 1% escalate to SEV2 and page oncall-sre
jen: added gif :sweat_smile: and reaction :thumbsup:
incident-bot: scheduled check-ins every 10m for 1h
omar: logging runbook steps in INC-2026-0314-1, will coordinate rollback if we see regression
alice: support will follow up with customer postmortem note + workaround
matt: creating PR to add autoscaler pre-warm capacity for nodegroup ng3
omar: acked handoff. marking thread as in-flight, won't close until stable <1.0s p99 for 30m
jen: good catch everyone, will follow up tomorrow on residual GC issue
luis: :eyes: monitoring KV eviction alerts
incident-bot: incident PD-4829 status updated -> monitoring
End of thread.
